name: kickoff_close_contested_win_pays_the_time_decay
description: A contested kickoff in miniature: the ball rests at the centre; blue starts 1200 uu away and orange 1400 uu away on the other side, both boost straight at it. Blue gets there first (a few steps ahead); orange is within 1500 uu of the ball at that moment, so the touch is contested. Hand calc: blue's nose reaches the ball after about 1050 uu, about 0.9 s under full throttle and boost = about step 14, so the reward is about 1 - 14/45 = 0.69 (a touch at step k pays 1 - k/45). Measured: blue touches at step 17, so 1 - 17/45 = 0.622 (+37.3 weighted). Orange earns nothing in the raw reward (the kickoff is resolved by blue's first touch).

expect.intent: blue touches the ball inside the 30-step window
a fast contested first touch pays about 1 - k/45 = 0.62 (k = 17)
about +37 at weight 60 for a quick contested win
the raw reward pays only the first toucher
